message.content:
Write a rigorous BYTE-EXACT differential test harness at /tmp/difftest.sh (bash, chmod +x).

Usage: /tmp/difftest.sh <path-to-rust-binary>
It compares that binary against the reference C++ binary /workspace/dataset/test17_executable and must compare **raw bytes**, never shell
variables (output can contain NUL bytes and invalid UTF-8, which command substitution mangles). So: run each
binary redirecting stdout to a temp FILE, capture the exit status, and compare with "cmp -s". Also compare exit
statuses. Compare stdout only (ignore stderr).

The corpus must cover at least all of these argv[1] values:
  - the 5 documented examples: hello / world / test123 / "Hello World" / "hello world test"
  - the empty string ""
  - the NO-ARGUMENT case (invoke each binary with zero extra args; expect exit 1, empty stdout)
  - the EXTRA-ARGUMENT case (pass 3 args; argv[2..] must be ignored)
  - every single byte value from 1..255 inclusive, passed as a 3-char string "X<byte>Y" so that shell handling
    of leading/trailing whitespace and newlines cannot hide a difference. (Byte 0 cannot appear in argv — skip it.)
    Build these with printf and pass them safely; do NOT go through command substitution that strips newlines.
  - percent-escape torture: "%" "%2" "%20" "%2F" "%2f" "%zz" "%2z" "%z2" "%%" "%%%" "%%20" "%%41" "%1%20" "%q%20"
    "abc%" "abc%2" "100%25" "%00" "%00A" "%0a" "%0A" "%41" "%61" "%aB" "%Ab" "%ff" "%FF" "%fe%ff" "%C3%A9" "%e9"
  - plus-sign / form encoding: "+" "a+b" "+%20+" "%2b" "%2B" "a+b+c"
  - reserved chars and structure-breakers: "?" "#" "&" "=" "/" ":" "@" "[" "]" "q=1&r=2" "a#b?c" "://" "?#"
    "http://x" "//" "\\" ".." "." "-" "_" "~" "-._~"
  - UTF-8 / multibyte: "café" "日本語" "naïve" "€" "🎉" "Ωmega" "\u00e9\u0301"
  - long inputs: 1000 'a' chars; 500 spaces; 300 repetitions of "%ff"
  - whitespace-y: " " "  leading" "trailing  " "\t" a literal newline, a literal CR, "a\nb"
  - RANDOM FUZZ: at least 400 random inputs of random length 1..64 built from random bytes drawn from
    /dev/urandom with NUL bytes stripped out. Generate them by writing bytes to a file and reading with a method
    that preserves them exactly (e.g. build the arg via a tiny helper that uses "tr -d '\\000'" over
    "head -c N /dev/urandom" written to a file, then pass it using xargs -0 or by exec-ing with the file content
    read into a bash variable via read -r -d '' which preserves everything except NUL). Ensure high bytes and
    '%' and '+' occur frequently: also generate 200 random inputs drawn from the biased alphabet
    "%+abcdefABCDEF0123456789 =&?#/~._-" which is far more likely to hit escape-parsing edges.

Output: print one line per FAILING case with a hex dump of both outputs (od -An -tx1) truncated to something
readable, plus the argv shown with printf %q. At the end print a summary line exactly of the form
  "TOTAL=<n> PASS=<n> FAIL=<n>"
and exit 0 if FAIL==0 else exit 1.

Make it robust: use mktemp -d, clean up, do not leak temp files, and make sure a failing case does not abort the
whole run (no set -e pitfalls). It must be fast enough to run ~1300 cases in well under a minute.

Sanity-check the harness itself before you finish, in two ways:
  1. Run "/tmp/difftest.sh /workspace/dataset/test17_executable" — comparing the reference against ITSELF must report FAIL=0 and exit 0.
     If it does not, your harness is buggy (likely arg-passing corruption) — fix it until it does.
  2. Write a deliberately WRONG 5-line shim (e.g. a bash script that prints uppercase hex, or just "echo hi")
     and confirm the harness reports FAIL>0 and exits 1. This proves it can actually detect divergence.
Report: the absolute harness path, the total case count, and the results of both sanity checks.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ============================================================================
# BYTE-EXACT differential test harness
#
#   usage: difftest.sh <path-to-candidate-binary>
#
# Compares the candidate against the reference C++ binary
# /workspace/dataset/test17_executable.
#
# Design notes (why it looks like this):
#   * Program stdout can contain NUL bytes and invalid UTF-8 (e.g. arg "%00A"
#     or "%ff"). Command substitution $( ) silently drops NULs and strips
#     trailing newlines, so outputs are NEVER put in shell variables. Each run
#     is redirected to a temp FILE and the two files are compared with `cmp -s`.
#   * Exit statuses are compared too.
#   * Only stdout is compared; stderr is discarded.
#   * argv values are built with `printf -v` (a builtin assignment, no
#     subshell) so every byte 1..255 survives intact, including \n, \r, %, \.
#   * No `set -e` / `set -o pipefail`: a failing case must never abort the run.
# ============================================================================

export LC_ALL=C            # byte semantics for ${#s} / ${s:o:n} / printf %q
unset LANG LC_CTYPE 2>/dev/null

REF=/workspace/dataset/test17_executable

if [ "$#" -lt 1 ]; then
    printf 'usage: %s <path-to-rust-binary>\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 2
fi
CAND=$1

case $CAND in
    */*) : ;;
    *) CAND=./$CAND ;;
esac

if [ ! -x "$REF" ]; then
    printf 'error: reference binary not executable: %s\n' "$REF" >&2
    exit 2
fi
if [ ! -x "$CAND" ]; then
    printf 'error: candidate binary not executable: %s\n' "$CAND" >&2
    exit 2
fi

TMPD=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/difftest.XXXXXXXX") || exit 2
cleanup() { rm -rf "$TMPD"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
trap 'cleanup; exit 130' INT TERM HUP

OUTR=$TMPD/ref.out
OUTC=$TMPD/cand.out
BLOBF=$TMPD/blob.bin

TOTAL=0; PASS=0; FAIL=0
MAXDUMP=96          # bytes of each output shown in a failure line
MAXFAILLINES=${MAXFAILLINES:-200}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers ----

# hexdump of a file, truncated, squeezed onto ONE line
dump_one_line() {
    local f=$1 n h
    n=$(wc -c < "$f")
    h=$(head -c "$MAXDUMP" "$f" | od -An -tx1 | tr '\n' ' ' | tr -s ' ')
    h=${h# }; h=${h% }
    if [ "$n" -gt "$MAXDUMP" ]; then h="$h ..(+$((n - MAXDUMP)))"; fi
    printf '%d bytes [%s]' "$n" "$h"
}

# run_case <label> [args...]      -- args are passed verbatim, may be zero of them
run_case() {
    local label=$1; shift
    local rr rc qa dr dc
    TOTAL=$((TOTAL + 1))

    "$REF"  "$@" >"$OUTR" 2>/dev/null; rr=$?
    "$CAND" "$@" >"$OUTC" 2>/dev/null; rc=$?

    if [ "$rr" -eq "$rc" ] && cmp -s "$OUTR" "$OUTC"; then
        PASS=$((PASS + 1))
        return 0
    fi

    FAIL=$((FAIL + 1))
    if [ "$FAIL" -le "$MAXFAILLINES" ]; then
        # printf %q renders every non-printable byte as $'\NNN', so this is
        # safe to route through command substitution.
        qa=$(printf '%q ' "$@")
        qa=${qa% }
        [ "$#" -eq 0 ] && qa='<no args>'
        dr=$(dump_one_line "$OUTR")
        dc=$(dump_one_line "$OUTC")
        printf 'FAIL#%d %s argv=(%s) exit ref=%d cand=%d | ref=%s | cand=%s\n' \
            "$FAIL" "$label" "$qa" "$rr" "$rc" "$dr" "$dc"
    elif [ "$FAIL" -eq $((MAXFAILLINES + 1)) ]; then
        printf '... (further failure lines suppressed; set MAXFAILLINES to raise)\n'
    fi
    return 1
}

# ------------------------------------------------------- corpus: the basics --

# 1) the 5 documented examples
run_case doc1 'hello'
run_case doc2 'world'
run_case doc3 'test123'
run_case doc4 'Hello World'
run_case doc5 'hello world test'

# 2) empty string argument
run_case empty ''

# 3) NO-ARGUMENT case: zero extra args (documented: exit 1, empty stdout)
run_case noargs

# 4) EXTRA-ARGUMENT cases: argv[2..] must be ignored
run_case extra3a 'hello' 'IGNORED' 'ALSO IGNORED'
run_case extra3b 'Hello World' '%41' ''
run_case extra3c '' 'x' 'y'
run_case extra3d 'a%20b' 'zzz' '%00'

# 5) every single byte value 1..255, as "X<byte>Y"
for ((b = 1; b < 256; b++)); do
    printf -v oct '%03o' "$b"
    printf -v arg 'X%bY' "\\0$oct"
    run_case "byte$b" "$arg"
done

# ------------------------------------------- corpus: hand-written torture ----

fixed_args=(
    # percent-escape torture
    '%' '%2' '%20' '%2F' '%2f' '%zz' '%2z' '%z2' '%%' '%%%' '%%20' '%%41'
    '%1%20' '%q%20' 'abc%' 'abc%2' '100%25' '%00' '%00A' '%0a' '%0A' '%41'
    '%61' '%aB' '%Ab' '%ff' '%FF' '%fe%ff' '%C3%A9' '%e9'
    # extra escape shapes
    '%-1' '%+1' '% 20' '%2 0' '%%2' '%g0' '%0g' '%7e' '%7E' '%25' '%2525'
    '%%%%' '%2%2%2' 'a%b%c' '%00%00' '%ff%' '%f' 'f%'
    # plus-sign / form encoding
    '+' 'a+b' '+%20+' '%2b' '%2B' 'a+b+c' '++' 'a++b' '+a' 'a+'
    # reserved chars and structure breakers
    '?' '#' '&' '=' '/' ':' '@' '[' ']' 'q=1&r=2' 'a#b?c' '://' '?#'
    'http://x' '//' '\' '..' '.' '-' '_' '~' '-._~'
    ';' ',' '$' '!' "'" '(' ')' '*' '"' '<' '>' '{' '}' '|' '^' '`'
    'q=' '=v' '&&' '=&=' 'a=b=c' '?q=1' '#frag' 'k=v#f' 'q=%26' 'q=a+b'
    '1&2&3' 'a&&b' '&a=1' 'a=1&' 'a==1'
    # UTF-8 / multibyte
    'café' '日本語' 'naïve' '€' '🎉' 'Ωmega'
    'ünïcødé' 'Ω' '𝔘𝔫𝔦' 'a¢b€c𐍈d'
)
i=0
for a in "${fixed_args[@]}"; do
    i=$((i + 1))
    run_case "fixed$i" "$a"
done

# combining sequence  U+00E9 U+0301  (bytes c3 a9 cc 81) -- built byte-exactly
printf -v combo '%b' '\0303\0251\0314\0201'
run_case combining "$combo"
printf -v combo2 '%b' 'e\0314\0201'
run_case combining2 "$combo2"

# whitespace-y cases (built with %b so nothing is lost)
printf -v w_sp   '%b' ' '
printf -v w_lead '%b' '  leading'
printf -v w_trl  '%b' 'trailing  '
printf -v w_tab  '%b' '\011'
printf -v w_nl   '%b' '\012'
printf -v w_cr   '%b' '\015'
printf -v w_anb  '%b' 'a\012b'
printf -v w_crlf '%b' 'a\015\012b'
printf -v w_mix  '%b' ' \011\012\015 '
printf -v w_nlt  '%b' 'trailing\012'
printf -v w_nll  '%b' '\012leading'
printf -v w_vt   '%b' 'a\013\014b'
for v in "$w_sp" "$w_lead" "$w_trl" "$w_tab" "$w_nl" "$w_cr" "$w_anb" \
         "$w_crlf" "$w_mix" "$w_nlt" "$w_nll" "$w_vt"; do
    i=$((i + 1))
    run_case "ws$i" "$v"
done

# long inputs
long_a=''
for ((k = 0; k < 100; k++)); do long_a+='aaaaaaaaaa'; done          # 1000 'a'
printf -v long_sp '%500s' ''                                        # 500 spaces
long_ff=''
for ((k = 0; k < 300; k++)); do long_ff+='%ff'; done                # 300 x %ff
long_pc=''
for ((k = 0; k < 200; k++)); do long_pc+='%'; done                  # 200 bare %
long_pl=''
for ((k = 0; k < 200; k++)); do long_pl+='a+'; done
run_case long_a_1000  "$long_a"
run_case long_sp_500  "$long_sp"
run_case long_ff_300  "$long_ff"
run_case long_pct_200 "$long_pc"
run_case long_plus    "$long_pl"

# -------------------------------------------------- corpus: random fuzzing ---

: "${SEED:=17}"
RANDOM=$SEED

rand32() { printf '%d' $(( ((RANDOM << 15) | RANDOM) & 0x3FFFFFFF )); }

# --- 400 fuzz cases over raw /dev/urandom bytes (NULs stripped) -------------
# One big blob is drawn once, written to a FILE, then slurped with
# `IFS= read -r -d ''` which preserves every byte (incl. \n, \r, high bytes,
# leading/trailing whitespace). Slicing under LC_ALL=C is byte-exact.
head -c 262144 /dev/urandom | tr -d '\000' > "$BLOBF"
BLOB=''
IFS= read -r -d '' BLOB < "$BLOBF"
blen=${#BLOB}

if [ "$blen" -lt 4096 ]; then
    printf 'warning: random blob too small (%d bytes); fuzz cases reduced\n' "$blen" >&2
fi

NFUZZ=400
for ((k = 0; k < NFUZZ; k++)); do
    len=$(( (RANDOM % 64) + 1 ))
    if [ $((blen - len)) -le 1 ]; then continue; fi
    off=$(( $(rand32) % (blen - len) ))
    frag=${BLOB:off:len}
    if [ -z "$frag" ]; then frag='x'; fi
    run_case "fuzz$k" "$frag"
done

# --- 200 fuzz cases over the biased escape-heavy alphabet -------------------
ALPHA='%+abcdefABCDEF0123456789 =&?#/~._-'
alen=${#ALPHA}
NBIAS=200
for ((k = 0; k < NBIAS; k++)); do
    len=$(( (RANDOM % 64) + 1 ))
    s=''
    for ((j = 0; j < len; j++)); do
        s+=${ALPHA:$((RANDOM % alen)):1}
    done
    run_case "bias$k" "$s"
done

# --- 100 extra fuzz cases: random high bytes spliced with % and + ----------
for ((k = 0; k < 100; k++)); do
    len=$(( (RANDOM % 24) + 1 ))
    if [ $((blen - len)) -le 1 ]; then continue; fi
    off=$(( $(rand32) % (blen - len) ))
    case $((RANDOM % 4)) in
        0) frag="%${BLOB:off:len}" ;;
        1) frag="${BLOB:off:len}%" ;;
        2) frag="+${BLOB:off:len}+" ;;
        *) frag="%2${BLOB:off:len}%" ;;
    esac
    run_case "mix$k" "$frag"
done

# -------------------------------------------------------------- summary -----

printf 'TOTAL=%d PASS=%d FAIL=%d\n' "$TOTAL" "$PASS" "$FAIL"
[ "$FAIL" -eq 0 ] && exit 0
exit 1
